method: All four-block pixel centres in current biome export; native region union per letter; exact shared-boundary samples assigned to first SVG region in source order; ocean palette0 excluded. No runtime chunk-boundary claim.
interpretation_limits: Areas describe current designed gameplay masks,not sovereign national borders or canonical climate percentages. Edge samples outside native coastline are reported separately. Final biome/noise/tree generation requires runtime tests.

biomes.scope: Designed four-block samples inside native gameplay mask; not surveyed sovereignty/climate or final in-game biome distribution
